budget_items.what_was_recorded: Current program requires 2 years enrollment with $2,000 individual and $4,000 family incentive; new program requires 1 year enrollment with $3,000 individual and $6,000 family incentive
budget_items.quote: right now employees must enroll in the town's health insurance for at least two years and then are eligible to opt out, when they opt out the receive a one year incentive of $2,000 for individual plan and $4,000 for a family plan. for the new proposed program, employees must enroll in the town's health insurance for at least one year and then they are eligible to opt out, and will receive a $3000 for individual and $6,000 for family incentive payment.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Committee recommended override amount to select board

public_comment.speaker: Laura Brzozoski
public_comment.quote: we need people to run for office, i'm not just talking about school committee. i'm talking about town wide. up for election this year is select board, sewer commission, board of health, assessors, school committee, park commission, commissioner of trust funds, cemetery commission, library trustee, planning board, and housing authority.

public_comment.speaker: Renee Emkey
public_comment.topic: Fourth shift fire department, budget priorities
public_comment.quote: the fourth shift is included in the override budget, the full ask of the fire department is not. the per diems were cut in half that impact is that we cannot man two ambulances in the no override budget, so that is the missing piece. this impacts safety and services of the town.

public_comment.speaker: Renee Emkey
public_comment.topic: No override budget impacts, importance of override passage
public_comment.quote: i first want to publicly thank the superintendent, chris, and the town manager all who spent a lot of time friday and over the weekend, looking at line items, expenses and looking into munis and a lot of it was incorporated into the budget.

public_comment.speaker: Sarah Camer
public_comment.quote: may 2 is a big sports day for a lot of people. i hope you are having a conversation with your student about how you might have to miss one of their athletic events. my daughter is going to states, i am not going, i have to go to town meeting.

public_comment.speaker: Laura Barooshian
public_comment.topic: Budget transparency, support for budget proposal, music education
public_comment.quote: i want to thank you for everything you are doing. i think there is a different feel this year and how you are all working together and the conversations you are having. there is transparency, i don't have to search for the budgets, and there is a hub on our town website that gives people, committees, and groups everyone's budget, i think this is phenomenal for the public.

public_comment.speaker: Sarah Call
public_comment.quote: the one thought that keeps coming back to me is last year we suddenly found almost $600,000 but then lost it and went to the town, i feel like before we move forward with another override, we should address how that money was lost and if there is a chance of getting it back.
